claims.head: The matchup inside the matchup
claims.body: The Capitals are near the top of the league for chance quality, and the Kraken are near the top of the league at preventing dangerous shots. Our lean: the Capitals’ chance quality wins out.
claims.call: The Capitals’ chances are more dangerous than the league average (a 6.3% chance of scoring on the average shot) against the Kraken.
claims.nums: Washington 6th for chance quality (a 6.7% chance of scoring on the average shot) · Seattle 6th for preventing dangerous shots
claims.gist: It’s strength against strength: the Capitals for chance quality, the Kraken at preventing dangerous shots.

claims.head: The Capitals get in close; the Kraken shoot from distance
claims.body: On shots from in close, Washington is near the top of the league and Seattle is around the middle of the league. That’s about as far apart as two teams get.
claims.nums: Shots from in close: Washington 8th, Seattle 22nd
claims.gist: The Capitals and the Kraken sit at opposite ends for shots from in close.
claims.call: The Capitals take a bigger share of their shots from within 20 feet than the Kraken.

notes.text: M. Roy is day to day (lower body injury) and has missed the last 2 games. He is a top-four defenseman. T. Liljegren has taken his spot beside J. Chychrun.

WSH.head: Washington should have the upper hand
WSH.body: Washington has had more of the chances over recent games and has home ice. Seattle can make it interesting if they pounce on loose pucks.

SEA.head: Seattle faces a real test
SEA.body: Washington has had more of the chances over recent games and has home ice. Seattle can pull it off if they pounce on loose pucks.

story.head: The matchup inside the matchup
paras: The Capitals have won two in a row. The Kraken are 3-2-0.
It’s strength against strength: the Capitals for chance quality, the Kraken at preventing dangerous shots. The Capitals and the Kraken sit at opposite ends for shots from in close.

items.text: Jordan Kyrou has seven goals in nine games against Seattle since 2023-24, most of them with St. Louis.
Bobby McMann has four goals in six games against Washington since 2023-24, most of them with Toronto.
Matt Roy has missed the Capitals’ last two games.
Alex Ovechkin is still looking for his first goal of the season.
